g.text: MX · where mail for the domain is delivered
— example.com publishes a null MX record, which tells
SPF · which servers may send its mail
DNS lookups. Ends with -all: mail from servers not listed
DMARC · what receivers do with mail that fails SPF and DKIM
: mail that fails DMARC is refused outright.
Without rua=, receivers don't send aggregate reports, so you can't see who sends mail as
example.com or whether your own mail passes.
Add rua=mailto:<address>, such as a dmarc-reports@example.com mailbox or a DMARC
DKIM · keys that sign its mail
says it sends no mail, so
there's nothing to sign. The empty
keys published for it say the same.
passed. See the suggestions marked ! above.
